propositions: Model tier selection is currently inferred from equality tests against the framework default, causing silent failures in downgrade logic and split-brain provider dispatching across workflow passes
A single scalar model config knob cannot express per-tier or per-pass model mappings, and Bedrock model IDs are treated as explicit operator choices rather than framework defaults

The Pass-1 model ladder in plan-review uses bare Anthropic names that resolve to direct Anthropic provider instead of respecting Bedrock configuration, causing 41-of-42 calls to split across providers
Class names (trivial/standard/frontier) must resolve through exactly three call sites (resolve_model, ladder expansion, verifier path) via a single resolution function to prevent divergence
Config layering via REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE must perform deep merges on table values while replacing arrays wholesale, so per-key overrides do not require restating entire class configurations
Operator-attested cross-provider gate run confirms per-pass class routing survives provider boundaries, with 41 frontier calls to Anthropic and 1 standard call to Bedrock as expected
